nvitk.segmentation.eicab.prune_eicab_outputs(out_dir: pathlib.Path, *, keep_aux_outputs: bool, keep_paths: Iterable[pathlib.Path] | None = None) → None¶

nvitk.segmentation.eicab.run_eicab(input_nii: str | pathlib.Path, output_dir: str | pathlib.Path, *, resolution: float = 0.625, simple_segmentation: bool = False, attention: bool = False, device: str = 'cpu', container: str | pathlib.Path, tmp_dir: str | pathlib.Path, keep_aux_outputs: bool = False, vasculature_host_path: str | pathlib.Path | None = None, check: bool = True, capture_output: bool = True) → subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]¶

Run eICAB via singularity run (same contract as legacy BioImaging).

vasculature_host_path should be the host directory bind-mounted to /programs/Neuro/vasculature2 (see run_eicab_inference.sh). When omitted and the path does not exist, the vasculature bind is skipped (only sensible for debugging).

nvitk.segmentation.eicab.segmentation_outputs_to_keep(out_dir: pathlib.Path) → list[pathlib.Path]¶

Pick CoW, whole-brain, and *_resampled NIfTIs; drop other intermediates.
